She told you that she was ready, that she had been waiting for this for her entire life.

You showed her the throne right beside yours.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "There began the days of Vina of Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: There began the days of Vina of House Toras, the Heir Apparent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She waved at the crowd that had gat..."
entries.dialogueText:
She waved at the crowd that had gathered around her. But behind the smiling faces and handshakes, you both knew that they were hiding daggers.

You showed her the throne right beside yours.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As if she understood what you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
As if she understood what you were thinking, she smiled and assured you that she would be fine.

You showed her the throne right beside yours.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You stood up and gathered {RiziaDLC..."
entries.dialogueText:
You stood up and gathered {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} in your arms. He laughed and pulled your hair. You could tell he was going to be strong, just like his mother. 

The whole room's attention was directed at you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...lifted your son up for everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: ...lifted your son up for everyone to see.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...demanded that everyone applaud t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...demanded that everyone applaud their future king.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told everyone to have fun and en..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told everyone to have fun and enjoy the celebrations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your subjects' applause resonated l..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your subjects' applause resonated loudly through the hall.

You put your child on your throne.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And so began the days of Prince Rom..."
entries.dialogueText: And so began the days of Prince Romus the Second of House Toras, the Heir Apparent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With no heir apparent on the horizo..."
entries.dialogueText:
With no heir apparent on the horizon, you could practically hear the whispers of your fellow nobles and see their eyes darting towards your throne.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...vowed that the reign of House To..."
entries.dialogueText: ...vowed that the reign of House Toras would continue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few months after your speech, the..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few months after your speech, the elections were all people talked about.

Despite the RPP's initial popularity, Daria de Rava quickly rose in the polls. Her speeches resonated with those who rejected the interim leadership's vision of extreme change.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "At long last, Rizians went to the b..."
entries.dialogueText: At long last, Rizians went to the ballot boxes to cast their votes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As expected, Sotelato won by a land..."
entries.dialogueText:
As expected, Sotelato won by a landslide to become the first elected Prime Minister of Rizia.

Just a day later, Lucita gave birth to your son {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}, competing with the elections in the news cycle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As expected, Daria won by a landsli..."
entries.dialogueText:
As expected, Daria won by a landslide to become the first elected Prime Minister of Rizia.

Just a day later, Lucita gave birth to your son, competing with the elections in the news cycle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Times were changing. But you were s..."
entries.dialogueText: Times were changing. But you were still King.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Times were changing."
entries.dialogueText: Times were changing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the eve of your eight-year jubil..."
entries.dialogueText:
On the eve of your eight-year jubilee, the new Prime Minister showed up at Palas Rezna for his first official meeting with you.

He arrived an hour late, explaining that he had gotten caught up in work. On top of that, he didn't bow to you at all.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...demanded an apology."
entries.dialogueText: ...demanded an apology.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...forgave the breach of protocol."
entries.dialogueText: ...forgave the breach of protocol.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told him to not be late next tim..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told him to not be late next time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He apologized with a shrug, saying..."
entries.dialogueText:
He apologized with a shrug, saying he would soon be working on a bill that removed the last traces of royal protocol from Rizian law.

He then pulled out a briefcase to inform you of his plans for Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the day of your eight-year jubil..."
entries.dialogueText:
On the day of your eight-year jubilee, the new Prime Minister showed up at Palas Rezna for her first official meeting with you.

Perfectly following royal protocol, she knelt before her monarch.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told her that she no longer had..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told her that she no longer had to kneel if she wished.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...waited for what Daria had to say..."
entries.dialogueText: ...waited for what Daria had to say.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...commended her for respecting her..."
entries.dialogueText: ...commended her for respecting her king.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pulled out a briefcase to infor..."
entries.dialogueText: She pulled out a briefcase to inform you of the most recent developments in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She refused respectfully. Afterw..."
entries.dialogueText:
She refused respectfully.

Afterwards, she pulled out a briefcase to inform you of the most recent developments in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She thanked you profusely. After..."
entries.dialogueText:
She thanked you profusely.

Afterwards, she pulled out a briefcase to inform you of the recent developments in Rizia.

The newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille} had decided to reach out recently. As fellow Wruhecists, they considered Rizia a natural ally.

Your advice was to...

entries.title: Narrator: "Wruhecists were fleeing Rizia for t..."
entries.dialogueText:
Wruhecists were fleeing Rizia for the newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille}, seeking religious freedom. Its militias had begun challenging your borders on the Rizian side.

A few clashes had already occurred.

Your advice was to...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...align with them, but not get too..."
entries.dialogueText: ...align with them, but not get too close.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...fully ally with them for the sak..."

entries.title: Narrator: "On the day of your eight-year jubil..."
entries.dialogueText:
On the day of your eight-year jubilee, the new Prime Minister showed up at Palas Rezna for his first official meeting with you.

He profusely apologized for arriving a few minutes late, explaining he'd gotten caught up in work.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled out a briefcase to inform..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled out a briefcase to inform you of the latest developments in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...warned him not to be late next t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...warned him not to be late next time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told him he didn't have to apolo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told him he didn't have to apologize.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...congratulated him on his electio..."
entries.dialogueText: ...congratulated him on his election victory.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You listened."
entries.dialogueText: You listened.

entries.title: Narrator: "A few months after your speech, the..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few months after your speech, the elections were all people talked about.

As the face behind the reform movement, Manus Sazon had gained incredible popularity during his tenure as transitory prime minister.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few months after your speech, the..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few months after your speech, the elections were all people talked about.

As interim Prime Minister, Daria de Rava ran an immensely successful campaign, enjoying incredible popularity among those who wanted life to stay as it was under your reign.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The newly independent {RiziaDLCText..."
entries.dialogueText:
The newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille} had decided to reach out recently, saying Rizia's acceptance of Golcondism made the kingdom a natural ally.

Your advice was to...

entries.title: Narrator: "Golcondists were fleeing Rizia for..."
entries.dialogueText:
Golcondists were fleeing Rizia for the newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille}, seeking religious freedom. Its militias had begun challenging your borders on the Rizian side.

A few clashes had already occurred.

Your advice was to...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The newly independent {RiziaDLCText..."
entries.dialogueText:
The newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille} had reached out to Adarfo after his victory, congratulating him and asking to open trade channels.

Your advice was to...

entries.dialogueText:
The newly independent {RiziaDLCText.IndependentZille} had begun challenging your borders on the Rizian side.

A few clashes had already occurred.

Your advice was to...

entries.title: Narrator: "With Zille still under Wehzek contr..."
entries.dialogueText:
With Zille still under Wehzek control, a few troublemakers had begun challenging your borders on the Rizian side.

Some clashes had already occurred.

Your advice was to...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the wake of the destabilization..."
entries.dialogueText:
In the wake of the destabilization the reformists had caused, many important facilities had been destroyed. 

Prime Minister Sotelato was planning a "Rebuild and Recover" campaign, during which high taxes on the rich would pay for the industrialization and modernization of Rizia on a mass scale.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...thought it would harm the people..."
entries.dialogueText: ...thought it would harm the people more than it would help.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...warned him against further upset..."
entries.dialogueText: ...warned him against further upsetting the nobility.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told him it sounded like a good..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told him it sounded like a good idea.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The recent period of economic insta..."
entries.dialogueText:
The recent period of economic instability had put many Rizians out of work, leading to a decrease in production capacity.

Prime Minister Sotelato was planning a "Rebuild and Recover" campaign, during which high taxes on the rich would pay for the industrialization and modernization of Rizia on a mass scale.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...focus all efforts on domestic en..."
entries.dialogueText: ...focus all efforts on domestic energy extraction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Finding new sources of energy was o..."
entries.dialogueText:
Finding new sources of energy was of the utmost importance to the government.

Rizia Prime Minister Sotelato was planning a "Refuel and Recover" campaign, during which high taxes on the rich would pay for research on modern extraction methods. 

You...

entries.title: Narrator: "Increasing Rizia's production capac..."

Prime Minister Sotelato was planning a "Rebuild and Recover" campaign, during which high taxes on the rich would pay for the industrialization and modernization of Rizia on a mass scale.

You...

entries.dialogueText:

Your advice was...

entries.title: Narrator: "The final item on the agenda concer..."
entries.dialogueText:
The final item on the agenda concerned GRACE.

In response to ongoing pressure from the superpowers, Queen Beatrice had proposed to transform the organization into a powerful military and financial alliance, on par with ATO or the CSP. 

Adarfo, on the other hand, wanted to withdraw from GRACE completely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to give GRACE whatever support i..."
entries.dialogueText: ...to give GRACE whatever support it needed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to consider Rizia's withdrawal."
entries.dialogueText: ...to consider Rizia's withdrawal.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...not to promise her anything."
entries.dialogueText: ...not to promise her anything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You encouraged him to go along with..."
entries.dialogueText: You encouraged him to go along with Beatrice's plan.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You approved his idea."
entries.dialogueText: You approved his idea.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You didn't advise him one way or th..."
entries.dialogueText: You didn't advise him one way or the other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The bells of Zilba Archsanctuary ra..."
entries.dialogueText: The bells of Zilba Archsanctuary rang in the distance, marking the end of your meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few months after your speech, you..."
entries.dialogueText: A few months after your speech, you strode into the Grand Hall for your jubilee celebrations, commemorating eight years of your reign.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The time had passed too quickly."
entries.dialogueText: The time had passed too quickly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It felt like eons since your corona..."
entries.dialogueText: It felt like eons since your coronation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You had much to celebrate."
entries.dialogueText: You had much to celebrate.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Later that evening, you strode into..."
entries.dialogueText: Later that evening, you strode into the Grand Hall for your jubilee celebrations, commemorating eight years of your reign.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was time to get ready."
entries.dialogueText: It was time to get ready.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A cordon of soldiers in crisp unifo..."
entries.dialogueText:
A cordon of soldiers in crisp uniforms performed a perfectly choreographed salute as you passed.

You took your seat on the Sila Orica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A cordon of Wruhec's Guardians knel..."
entries.dialogueText:
A cordon of Wruhec's Guardians knelt and reverently murmured your name as you passed.

You took your seat on the Sila Orica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The band played a series of ceremon..."
entries.dialogueText:
The band played a series of ceremonial fanfares as you walked past your many prestigious guests. Each of them bowed reverently as you passed.

You took your seat on the Sila Orica.

entries.dialogueText: You looked to your left.

You...

entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wondered if Lena would be proud..."

You...

entries.dialogueText: ...knew you'd keep Sal around as long as he was of use to you, and no longer.

You...

You...

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

You...
